messages:
clara_releng: FYI prepping private VPC handoff for release v1.6.4. There's a cert rotation on the bridge/proxy that might invalidate existing transport tunnels. Need decision: rotate certs now and stagger canary slots, or keep current certs and push cert rotation to next window?

dave_sre: how urgent is cert rotation? Are the certs expiring soon?

clara_releng: They expire in ~9 days. We can postpone but airgap partners want signed manifests tomorrow. If we rotate, we must re-sign offline bundles and re-calc checksums.

frank_packaging: If we rotate, we should pin the installer image tag and publish a stable submanifest to the offline bundle. Otherwise partners' transport daemons fail during handshake.

emma_eng: suggested approach: open two canary slots (canary-a, canary-b) for a staggered validation. push rotated certs to canary-a first, validate transfer + cosign chain, then promote to canary-b and full. If failure, rollback by swapping back to old certs and republishing old signed bundle.

ira_security: fine but need KMS audit entries and new cosign key TTL bump. Also update manifest signer list and record key thumbprints in the release notes.

clara_releng: Procedural checklist (will run in order):

```
- Pin installer: redwood/installer:v1.6.4-pinned-2026-03-20
- Generate cosign: cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/packaging-key
- Build offline bundle: scripts/build_offline.sh --submanifest=sealed-2026-03-20.tar.gz
- Compute checksums: sha256sum sealed-2026-03-20.tar.gz > sealed.sha256
- Publish submanifest to offsite mirror and mirror-backup
```

deploy-bot: deploy window reserved 2026-03-22 02:00-06:00 UTC. Canary slots reserved 02:00-03:15 (canary-a), 03:30-04:30 (canary-b). Backout cutoff 04:45 UTC.

dave_sre: I'll run preflight: proxy cert chain verify + transport handshake smoke. Commands I'll run:

```
openssl s_client -connect bridge-proxy.internal:443 -CAfile roots.pem
curl -v https://mirror.test/manifest -H "Authorization: Bearer test-token"
```

frank_packaging: Also note: we'll add a delta manifest so customers with partial images can resume. Delta generation script may change artifact size ~+1.2MB; need to include delta sha256 in the sealed.sha256.

emma_eng: For rollback plan: keep previous bundle on offsite mirror for 72h and tag as v1.6.3-stable. If rollback, operations will restore old cosign signature entry and update submanifest pointer to the stable tag. Documented steps in runbook.

clara_releng: Agree. I'll create release notes snippet and send to partners channel after canary-a passes. Anyone object to schedule? @ira_security @dave_sre

ira_security: No objections, will audit keys tonight and send KMS thumbprints. Also will run a quick cosign verify against the signed tarball pre-publish.

dave_sre: I'll be online for the window and monitor transport logs. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Note: If canary failure occurs, automatic fallback triggers after 10m and will pin route to dedicated-staging. See /deploybot rollback docs for manual override.

clara_releng: Great. Starting packaging job now, will paste sealed.sha256 + cosign output in this thread when done. Thanks team.
